title: next to field not summary only
name: Next to the field, not summary only
rule: Put the error next to the field in error; a top validation summary must not be the only indication.

citation.source: NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§3, §8); Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Error Messages (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia); Vercel Web Interface Guidelines

pass_when: Error text sits next to the field; if a summary exists, field-level indication is also present.
fail_when: Only a distant banner, dialog, or summary list; the field itself has no error copy.
overview: Error text sits next to the field; a summary alone is not enough.
apply_when: Showing validation failures on fields after submit or completed input.
not_when: Page-level system outages that are not tied to a specific input.
agent_hint: Place error copy beside the field; never rely on a distant summary alone.
description: Put the error next to the field in error so the fix is visible at the cause. A top validation summary must not be the only indication — if a summary exists, field-level indication is also present. Apply when showing validation failures on fields after submit or completed input. Fail only a distant banner, dialog, or summary list when the field itself has no error copy.
